title: THE QUEEN MOTHER
sub: Nanyue's queen mother was a woman from the north, and one Han envoy, Sima Qian says, had once been her lover.
say: Nahn-yweh's queen mother was a woman from the north, and one Han envoy, Suh-mah Chyen says, had once been her lover.

title: JOIN HAN?
sub: She and the young king asked to join Han, under Han law.
say: She and the young king asked to join Han, under Han law.

title: LÜ JIA
sub: The minister Lü Jia, trusted by the Yue, refused, and called her a woman of the Central States, ready to hand its treasures to Han.
say: The minister Lyoo Jyah, trusted by the Yweh, refused, and called her a woman of the Central States, ready to hand its treasures to Han.

title: 112 BC
sub: In 112 BC, he killed the king, the queen mother and the Han envoys, and put another prince on the throne.
say: In 112 BC, he killed the king, the queen mother and the Han envoys, and put another prince on the throne.

title: 111 BC
sub: Emperor Wu sent armies and river fleets south. In the winter of 111 BC, Panyu burned and surrendered.
say: Emperor Wu sent armies and river fleets south. In the winter of 111 BC, Pahn-yoo burned and surrendered.

title: 93 YEARS
sub: Five generations, ninety-three years, Sima Qian counts. Then the kingdom was gone.
say: Five generations, ninety-three years, Suh-mah Chyen counts. Then the kingdom was gone.

title: WHOSE KINGDOM?
sub: So who gets to claim it today?
say: So who gets to claim it today?
